_doc: 공포 1화 실사 컷. 한글 글자가 들어가는 쪽지·휴대폰은 코드 그림으로 두고, 사진이 필요한 공간만 뽑는다. 얼굴은 절대 또렷하게 보여주지 않는다.
style: photorealistic, 35mm film still, Korean convenience store at 3am, cold flickering fluorescent light, deep shadows, heavy film grain, muted desaturated green-blue tones, unsettling, liminal, no text, no watermark, vertical composition

items.name: cctv-door
items.prompt: grainy black and white security camera footage from a high ceiling corner, looking down at the glass entrance door of a small empty convenience store at night, a tall thin pale woman with very long black hair covering her face standing perfectly still just outside the glass door, low resolution CCTV, fisheye distortion

items.name: door-pov
items.prompt: view from behind the cashier counter looking toward the glass front door of a small empty convenience store at night, outside the glass door stands a tall thin woman in a white dress with long black hair completely covering her face, she is standing perfectly still, pitch black street behind her

items.name: door-close
items.prompt: close view of a convenience store glass door at night from inside, a pale thin hand with long fingers pressed flat against the glass from outside, behind it the dark blurred shape of a woman with long black hair leaning close, face hidden in shadow, condensation on glass

items.name: door-empty
items.prompt: view from behind the cashier counter toward the glass front door of a completely empty convenience store at night, no people at all, nobody, pitch black outside, a faint wet handprint smeared on the glass door

items.name: cctv-behind
items.prompt: grainy black and white security camera footage from a high ceiling corner looking down at the cashier counter of a convenience store at night, a young male cashier seen from behind looking at his phone, and directly behind him, inches away, a tall pale woman with very long black wet hair hanging over her face, head tilted, low resolution CCTV, fisheye distortion
